intake_architecture.runtime_modifications: NONE (zero production runtime or agent changes; benchmark intake isolated)

UNAUTHORIZED_TRUTH_READ.trigger: Executor attempts to read files matching *truth* or containing ground_truth_manifest.
UNAUTHORIZED_TRUTH_READ.enforcement: File access denied; execution halts with AUDIT_HALT_SECURITY_VIOLATION.

MISSING_CUSTODIAN.trigger: Execution launch requested without verified external custodian identity and cryptographic signature.

INVALID_SEAL.trigger: Package commitment hash does not match SHA256(payload || nonce).

CASE_HASH_DRIFT.trigger: Delivered case input content differs from pre-registered manifest hash.

TRUTH_HASH_DRIFT.trigger: Disclosed truth manifest differs from pre-registered truth commitment hash.

DUPLICATE_CASE_ID.trigger: Multiple case bundles share an identical qualification_case_id.

EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE.trigger: Case bundle references scenarios or entities from F1-F4 development fixtures.

CANDIDATE_HASH_DRIFT.trigger: Prompt candidate hash differs from e00c1549... or schema hash differs from a214ec4f....

UNSEALED_ANSWER_LEAKAGE.trigger: Truth answers or expected dispositions found embedded in ModelVisibleCaseInput.
UNSEALED_ANSWER_LEAKAGE.enforcement: Package flagged as contaminated; execution halted.
